prompt:
Use case: game-asset, complete parcel sprite. Generate ONE native transparent RGBA square 1024x1024 finished city parcel. Reference image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE GEOMETRY GUIDE: keep its rectangular ground polygon, its four ground corners, both building masses and ground positions, parallel edges, height silhouettes, camera and canvas framing. Reference image 2 is PAINTING/MATERIAL DETAIL ONLY; do not copy its streets, camera or scene layout. This is a new production sprite, not a concept poster.
The guide is a flat 22m along-street by 18m deep parcel, two separate low buildings, 9m/10.5m high. Camera strictly orthographic looking DOWN at elevation62.5deg above horizontal and plan azimuth45deg. Keep the guide's high view and broad roof shapes; roof/wall edges must follow the guide rather than conventional low isometric. Do not rotate or reframe it. Keep native square canvas margins. Exact ground corner positions in 1024 canvas: (952,566),(658,140),(72,458),(366,884). Ground front/street edge runs from (366,884) to (952,566), the lower-right-facing boundary. The road is OUTSIDE this edge and MUST NOT be drawn. No asphalt road stripe/road anywhere.
Paint the left building as an elegant warm ivory 3-storey neighborhood bakery/cafe, right building as a complementary 4-storey cream modern apartment above small shop. Rich restrained architectural design: recessed blue-grey glass, slender balcony rails, a small warm orange shop awning, varied real roof vents and skylight, nuanced stone/plaster, no plastic boxes. Preserve the two footprint positions and guide height envelopes; no extra buildings or floors. BOTH MAIN DOORS on the visible long lower-right-facing STREET facade, located at the guide's two brown marks; connected to the street edge by fine taupe entry brick paths. Leave a useful forecourt roughly4.5m from front boundary to wall, not a huge empty plaza.
Design the WHOLE parcel ground coherently: cream sidewalk slabs and border courses, taupe entry brick areas, a narrow side/rear garden, modest benches/bicycle stand, a few shrubs, three modest trees maximum in visible SOIL/SHORT GRASS planting pools with low stone rims and short restrained iron fence segments. Trees stay rooted in ground, NEVER on roofs. Guide green marks are ground-tree candidates, never copy a green mark onto a roof. Keep street boundary clear and trees/canopies inside parcel. Behind the two buildings complete quiet planted courtyard/utility paving. A few cafe chairs by the proper front door. No people, rider, cars, vehicles, UI, labels, logos, lettering or watermark.
STYLE: highly polished bright Japanese urban anime painted game architecture, natural detailed surfaces, warm off-white/cream stone, subtle grey roof variation, restrained orange, modest fresh greenery, NO blue color cast. Lighting fixed from screen upper-left, visible soft coherent down/right cast shadows between buildings, trees and paving, and contact shadows at wall bases. Do not add a thick diorama base, dirt cliff, or extruded foundation slab: wafer-thin ground region with clean alpha edge so it lays on an engine map. All outside the exact parcel is truly transparent; include no checkerboard backdrop. Native transparency, preserve whole ground silhouette and building tops with margin. Final artwork must be detailed like image2 while keeping image1 geometry.
